desc: Derive the reverse-processing argument: when processing \(i\) backward, the \(P_i\)-th currently available final position is the slot occupied by \(i\).
Implement a Fenwick tree with point removal and efficient k-th-prefix selection.
Initialize all \(N\) positions as available and process \(i=N,N-1,\ldots,1\).
Store each value in its selected position and print the final array.
Ensure one-based indexing, fast input/output, and \(O(N\log N)\) complexity for \(N\le 5\times10^5\).
